description: Repository-specific Renovate rules on top of the shared Pulumi preset.

Inherited from the preset: minor and patch updates >= 1.0 grouped per manager (go, npm, github actions, mise), 'pulumi sdk' grouped (Go sdk + pkg, npm SDK and .pulumi.version move together), each 0.x minor and each major in its own PR, weekly schedule, build(deps) commit subjects.

packageRules.description: The Go language version (go directive, also read by mise through vfox-pulumi) changes the CI toolchain: keep it out of the library group so a Go bump is reviewed on its own.
Node: only even majors (LTS); odd releases are short-lived and never worth a PR.
Python and .NET are the floor supported by the generated SDKs: patches only, a minor or major bump is a deliberate decision.
